column1: Purpose: Log every other growth input that doesn't fit on a platform tab, newsletters, cold emails, partnership outreach, sales calls, and more.
1. This tab covers everything without its own platform tab. If one of these grows into a big part of what you do, copy a platform tab, rename it, and remove that item from this dropdown.
2. Log one row every time you complete one of these activities. Pick the Content Type from the dropdown, Platform fills in on its own based on what you picked.
3. Add a short Title or Description and the URL or reference if there is one, and set Quantity.
4. Pull this data automatically if you can. Otherwise update it manually at least once a day.
